name: cobol-comment-entry-fixed-layout-only
body: comment_header recognises an AUTHOR, INSTALLATION, DATE-WRITTEN, DATE-COMPILED, SECURITY or REMARKS header in area A under fixed layout, and the lexer then drops lines until the next line with a non-blank in area A. Limit: free-format sources keep their comment-entry text as tokens, and a header with a stray period before the word is missed. Upgrade when free-format programs with comment entries appear in a corpus.
